instructions: This directory contains Next.js App Router pages and API routes.
- Use Next.js 15 App Router conventions for file-based routing
- API routes should be in api/ subdirectory with route.ts files
- Implement proper HTTP methods (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE) as named exports
- Use Next.js Request/Response objects for API handling
- Implement proper error handling and status codes
- Follow the established patterns for OpenAI API integration
- Use proper middleware and error boundaries
- Handle CORS and security headers appropriately
- Validate request bodies and query parameters

api_routes.turn_response: Main chat completion endpoint with streaming
api_routes.functions: Custom function implementations for tool calls

patterns.error_handling: Return proper HTTP status codes with error messages
